title: Ayush Shetty Exits Denmark Open After First Round Loss
indian_angle: This report details the performance of young Indian men's singles player Ayush Shetty in a major international tournament.
summary: Indian shuttler Ayush Shetty was defeated by Alwi Farhan in the first round of the Denmark Open, leaving Kidambi Srikanth as the sole Indian men's singles contender.

title: BAI Announces Formation of New Athletes Committee
indian_angle: The formation of the BAI Athletes Committee provides a direct voice for Indian badminton players in the sport's governance.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This new scoring system will significantly impact how junior domestic ranking tournaments and national championships are played in India.
